# GitHub Pages setup

1. In GitHub, open the repository settings.
2. Go to Pages.
3. Choose GitHub Actions as the source.
4. Push this repository to a branch that matches the workflow trigger, such as main, master, or develop.
5. After the workflow completes, the site will be available at:
   https://<your-github-username>.github.io/<repository-name>/

If you use a custom environment name in the workflow, make sure it exists in GitHub under Settings → Environments.
